item.title: Linux Snippet: File Permissions & Ownership
item.description: Users familiar with Linux based operating systems should have at least once come across issues related to Permission denied when executing some commands in the terminal. This article aims to shed some light on user permissions and ownership related to files and directories. In order to get an introduction to permissions and ownership, in the terminal, navigate to a location where files resides and execute ls -al to list files and directories with all associated details.

item.title: SQL Snippet: Foreign Keys
item.description: If you have worked with SQL based database, I guess y’all are familiar with usage of foreign keys to manage relationship between tables. Relationship Types Lets dive into a famous example involving book — author connection to gain insight. There are variety of connection between these entities, in a graphical: one to one →an author can write only one book, and a book only have one author. one to many →an author can write multiple books, but book can only have one author.

item.title: Introduction to React Hooks
item.description: From React’s version 16.8.0, Hooks are introduced to make functional components more useful.
